title: crotonogyne stenophylla
intro: Crotonogyne stenophylla, commonly known as the 'Croton', is a species of flowering plant in the family Euphorbiaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin infections, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Crotonogyne stenophylla include analgesic and antipyretic effects, which help in relieving pain and reducing fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
